title: Resident Evil: The Board Game
subtitle: Cooperative survival horror campaign uncovering the viral nightmares of the Spencer Mansion
tagline: Enter the world of survival horror where every bullet counts
loreSummary: Trapped within the macabre halls of the remote Spencer Mansion, S.T.A.R.S. alpha team must ration scarce ammunition, evade relentless biological abominations, and solve lethal puzzles before the viral outbreak claims their lives.
keyFeatures: Tile-based exploration where opening doors dynamically expands the mansion layout
Dynamic Tension Deck driving resource attrition, jump scares, and escalating danger
Choice-driven narrative campaign where party decisions trigger lasting consequences
Faithful tabletop adaptation of the iconic survival horror masterpiece

re_mansion_campaign.name: Full Spencer Mansion Campaign
re_mansion_campaign.description: The complete 19-scenario survival horror investigation spanning the main estate, guardhouse, subterranean caverns, and Umbrella laboratory.

re_mansion_investigation.name: Mansion Breach & Guardhouse
re_mansion_investigation.description: Short exploratory campaign focusing on the ground floor, upper residence, and defeating the Guardhouse bio-abomination (~10 scenarios).

re_true_survivor.name: True Survivor Completionist
re_true_survivor.description: Exhaustive campaign uncovering all secret rooms, alternate character rescue paths, high-danger encounters, and optional side objectives (~25 scenarios).

milestones.title: The First Floor Horrors
milestones.description: Investigate the ominous dining hall and bloodstained corridors, locate the Armor Key, and survive the initial infected encounters.

milestones.title: Nightshade in the Guardhouse
milestones.description: Cross the courtyard into the overgrown guardhouse, synthesize chemical compounds, and eliminate the mutated botanical anomaly.

milestones.title: The Shackled Sorrow
milestones.description: Descend into dark mining tunnels beneath the estate, evade apex predators, and survive encounters with the chained test subject.

milestones.title: Umbrella Laboratory Protocol
milestones.description: Restore auxiliary generator power to the subterranean bio-research facility, bypass security locks, and uncover the viral conspiracy.

milestones.title: Dawn at the Heliport
milestones.description: Trigger the self-destruct countdown, signal the extraction helicopter from the rooftop helipad, and defeat the ultimate bioweapon.
